caption: The video captures an outdoor round metal fire barrel set on snow-dusted gravel, viewed from a high angle. The left half of the opening holds a pile of thin sticks and split wood already burning with orange-yellow flames, while the right half is covered by a perforated metal grate carrying a small silver pot. A bent metal handle spans the middle, separating the burning side from the grated side. The flames continuously flicker, rise, and lean, their tongues shifting position and brightness over the wood pile. Glowing embers and reddish wood surfaces brighten and dim as the fire consumes the kindling. Thin wisps of pale smoke drift near the center and right of the opening. The wood pile, grate, pot, and barrel rim remain in place, and the snow-and-gravel background appears steady. The fire continues burning throughout.
